requirement:
The user should be able to search for a product.

When the user enters a valid product search term, matching products should be displayed.

Search should be case-insensitive and support partial matching.

Search should check both product name and product description.

Display 10 products per page when multiple products match.

When the user searches for a product that does not exist, display:
"No products found".
